name: 993 Turbo charge-air pressure pipes, left and right (PicoGK concept)
material_candidate: PA12 SLS (concept assumption; the PET lines are rubber/composite pressure hoses and the record leaves the material unknown)
picogk_enhancement: Concept base model of the two pos 19 pressure pipes (turbo to intercooler) only; the cooler, air guide, bracket, sleeve, sensor and clamps of the record are not modelled. Each pipe is a smooth swept S-bend whose bore grows from the turbo-end to the cooler-end diameter, with straight clamp cuffs and rolled retention beads, filleted as one solid and open at both ends. Its length, height and width are solved to fill the FVD replacement-hose product envelopes; the routing, bend shape and every interface are assumptions. A rigid printed duct does not reproduce the decoupling a flexible hose gives between engine and body. The two organic ties only hold the pair together for display.

hose_length_mm.note: FVD replacement hose 99311063356 (left) declares 430 mm length; the right hose 99311063256 declares the same (catalog/sources/src-fvd-993-intercooler-hose-left-dimensions.json, -right-). Aftermarket product envelope, not OEM geometry; read as the end-to-end length along x

hose_left_height_mm.note: FVD left hose 99311063356 declares 115 mm height (product envelope); the vertical offset of the left S-bend is solved to fill it

hose_right_height_mm.note: FVD right hose 99311063256 declares 90 mm height (product envelope); the vertical offset of the right S-bend is solved to fill it

hose_width_mm.note: FVD left and right hoses both declare 70 mm width; the lateral offset of each pipe is solved to fill it (not an envelope check: the display pair is wider than one pipe)

turbo_end_bore_mm.note: FVD reinforced kit FVD12399300 declares diameters '43/57 mm' (catalog/sources/src-fvd-993-reinforced-intercooler-hose-kit-dimensions.json); reading 43 as the turbo-end bore is the concept interpretation, not a measured OEM interface

cooler_end_bore_mm.note: FVD kit '43/57 mm'; reading 57 as the intercooler-end bore is the concept interpretation

cuff_length_mm.note: straight clamp land at each end; clamp widths (pos 20/21, 60-80/12 and 40-60/9) are not cuff lengths

bend_handle_fraction.note: cubic Bezier handle length as a fraction of the bend run; horizontal tangents at both cuffs

bead_height_mm.note: rolled hose-retention bead height above the cuff

bead_inset_mm.note: bead position from each end face

pair_spacing_mm.note: display spacing between the two turbo-end axes; not the car's routing

tie_radius_mm.note: display tie radius; the ties hold the pair as one body and are not part of either pipe

tie_t1.note: position of the first display tie along the centreline points (0..1)

tie_t2.note: position of the second display tie along the centreline points (0..1)

fillet_mm.note: outer blend of beads and ties into the pipe skin (organic tie roots)

open_interfaces: K16 compressor-outlet and intercooler connector diameters, spigot lengths and bead profiles
real routing between the turbochargers and the intercooler, and engine-to-body movement
air guide, bracket, sleeve and temperature sensor of the record (not modelled)
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
